# MoodleGPT 3

> Browser extension and AI study assistant designed for Moodle quiz environments, powered by Google Gemini multimodal models and a shared question database.

## Product Overview
MoodleGPT 3 is a specialized browser extension for Chromium-based browsers that seamlessly interfaces with Moodle Learning Management System (LMS) quiz interfaces. It parses question text, visual diagrams, mathematical formulas, and answer options, delivering instant verified answers and AI-generated solutions with humanized automation capabilities.

## Licensing and Pricing
- **Commercial Software:** Requires an active license key for activation and ongoing access to core features.
- **Transparency:** Licensing terms, tiers, and requirements are explicitly disclosed on the official website and inside the extension setup panel prior to purchase.
- **Independent Maintenance:** License fees sustain continuous backend infrastructure, real-time database synchronization, and regular updates following Moodle LMS platform changes.

## AI Engine & API Integration
- **Primary AI Provider:** Built to interface natively with Google's Gemini API.
- **Model Support:** Continuously updated to support Google's latest multimodal Gemini models (including Flash and Pro tiers) as soon as they are released by Google AI.
- **Cost Efficiency & BYOK:** Supports user-provided Google Gemini API keys from Google AI Studio. Users can take full advantage of Google's free-tier rate limits, eliminating mandatory per-query API surcharges.
- **Multimodal Visual Processing:** Automatically detects and captures embedded images, graphs, anatomy diagrams, schematics, and UI screenshots, transmitting them directly to Gemini Vision endpoints for visual question processing.
- **Complex Logic & Negative Phrasing:** Leverages the latest Gemini models to evaluate complex reasoning constraints, including negative-filter stems ("NOT", "EXCEPT", "LEAST"), matching sets, and multi-variable logic.

## Dual Answering Architecture & Database
MoodleGPT 3 combines an internal question-and-answer caching system with generative AI to optimize response speed and reduce external API consumption:
- **Verified Answers Mode:** Pulls strictly from pre-validated, verified database entries to ensure high answer accuracy, instant response times (<50ms), and eliminate model hallucination risks.
- **Live Mode (User-Configurable):** An optional, opt-in collaborative mode. When toggled on, questions and extracted answers are shared in real time across active sessions, making solutions immediately available to minimize API quotas. Users retain full control to enable or disable Live Mode at any time.
- **Automatic Fallback:** If a question is not yet present in the verified database, MoodleGPT 3 automatically queries Google Gemini, formats the solution, and displays it seamlessly.

## Stealth Architecture & Anti-Detection
- **Shadow DOM Isolation:** Operates within an isolated Shadow DOM container (or runs in pure stealth mode without persistent DOM elements) to remain discreet and invisible to standard page scripts.
- **Humanized Automation:** Automation routines simulate genuine human behavior with randomized click delays, non-linear timing intervals, and natural interaction pauses.
- **Discreet UI Controls:** Fully adjustable overlay opacity (from 0% to 100%), compact floating pill widget, and seamless dark/light theme integration matching institutional Moodle designs.
- **Panic / Stealth Hotkey (Alt + X):** Emergency hotkey that instantly dismisses all overlays and extension UI elements from view in 0 milliseconds.

## Supported Question Types
MoodleGPT 3 features robust, battle-tested parsing across all major Moodle LMS question formats:
- **Multiple Choice (Single Answer):** Standard radio-button questions.
- **Multiple Choice (Multi-Select):** Multi-checkbox questions ("Select one or more", "Check all that apply").
- **True / False:** Binary evaluation questions.
- **Fill-in-the-Blanks (Cloze):** Inline text inputs and multi-part embedded answers.
- **Dropdown Selections:** Select dropdowns embedded within text paragraphs.
- **Short Answer & Numerical:** Open-ended text fields, units, and numeric tolerance ranges.
- **Matching Questions:** Drag-and-drop or select menus pairing items across lists.
- **Mathematical & Scientific Notation:** Full parsing for LaTeX, MathJax formulas, chemistry equations, and code blocks.
- **Essay & Long-Form Assistant:** Writing companion offering structured outlines, thesis formulation, and text drafts for open-ended questions.

## Automation & Keyboard Productivity
- **Interactive Double-Click:** Double-clicking any question stem triggers immediate solution extraction.
- **Keyboard Shortcuts:**
  - `Alt + Q`: Extract question text and show AI answer overlay.
  - `Alt + A`: Automatically select the correct answer on the active question.
  - `Alt + C`: Auto-select answer and automatically advance to the next quiz page.
  - `Alt + X`: Emergency panic switch (instantly hide all extension UI).
- **Full Quiz Automation:** Hands-free quiz progression with user-configurable delay timers between questions.

## Multilingual Capabilities
- **Universal Quiz Solving:** Successfully parses, translates, and answers quizzes in any language worldwide.
- **Interface Localization:** Extension settings, popups, and controls are localized into 5 languages: English, Portuguese, Spanish, French, and German.

## Privacy, Security & Data Protection
- **Zero Telemetry / Zero Personal Data:** MoodleGPT 3 does not collect names, student IDs, school logins, or personal profile data.
- **Direct Client-to-API Communication:** Prompts are sent directly from the client browser to Google's official Gemini API endpoints.
- **Encrypted Local Storage:** API keys and user configurations remain strictly inside the user's local browser environment.

## Compatibility & System Requirements
- **Platform:** Moodle LMS (versions 3.x, 4.x, and custom institutional themes).
- **Environment:** Desktop Chromium-based browsers (Google Chrome, Microsoft Edge, Brave, Opera, Vivaldi).
